Rebuilds Museum Explorer around three independent modes: verified 90/180-minute visit planning, concise on-site guidance, and sourced post-visit memory. Adds six venue starter packs, reusable templates, and a historical example while removing stale live indexes and automatic file-writing behavior.

Initial release of museum-explorer skill.

- Provides an end-to-end workflow: pre-visit research, on-site exhibition experience, and post-visit journaling.
- Generates curatorial cards with reliable museum/exhibition info, recommended exhibits, and shareable selections.
- Supports deep exhibit interpretation and minimalist checklists for on-site use.
- Creates realistic exhibit stamps and printable digital journals after the visit.
- Emphasizes rigorous information verification, source attribution, and copyright compliance.
